title: Moss Catalog: invalidate a cache entry after writing
body: The author says invalidating after the write removes stale cache reads, including concurrent readers.
contracts: cache is a synchronous Map. Each read and update uses the same Map for this model; no distributed cache is shown.
db.write atomically commits its value before fulfillment; rejection leaves the stored value unchanged.
db.read captures a snapshot when invoked, but its promise may fulfill after a later write commits.
read is unchanged. No generation check, cancellation, TTL, or synchronization of in-flight readers is supplied.
